name: recast
title: Recast
description: Rewrite, polish, and translate text with Claude on Amazon Bedrock using your own AWS account.
author: martin_sakowski

commands.name: rewrite-selected
commands.title: Rewrite Selected Text
commands.description: Rewrite selected text with your default tone, or enter text manually
commands.subtitle: Recast

commands.name: rewrite-with-tone
commands.title: Rewrite with Tone
commands.description: Rewrite text with a Friendly, Professional, Concise, Polished, or Neutral tone
commands.subtitle: Recast

commands.name: rewrite-with-instruction
commands.title: Rewrite with Custom Instruction
commands.description: Rewrite or translate text with your own instruction
commands.subtitle: Recast

preferences.name: credentialMethod
preferences.title: Credential Method
preferences.description: Use AWS SDK credentials, a named AWS CLI profile, or environment variables inherited by Raycast. See the setup guide for SSO and credential_process.

preferences.name: awsProfile
preferences.title: AWS Profile
preferences.description: AWS CLI profile name. Only used when Credential Method is set to 'Named Profile'.

preferences.name: awsRegion
preferences.title: AWS Region
preferences.description: AWS region for Bedrock runtime (e.g. us-east-1, eu-central-1)

preferences.name: modelId
preferences.title: Model ID
preferences.description: Base Bedrock model ID, without a geography prefix. The Inference Profile setting supplies the prefix. An inference profile ARN is used unchanged.

preferences.name: inferenceProfile
preferences.title: Inference Profile
preferences.description: Global may process text outside your AWS Region. Choose a geography for regional routing, or None for direct invocation. Availability depends on the model and source Region; see the setup guide.

preferences.name: maxTokens
preferences.title: Max Tokens
preferences.description: Maximum response tokens (1–65536; your model may have a lower limit). Incomplete rewrites cannot be pasted. Increase this for long selections.

preferences.name: temperature
preferences.title: Temperature
preferences.description: Optional value from 0 to 1. Leave empty for Claude Haiku 5.5 and other models with restricted sampling parameters.
preferences.placeholder: Leave empty for the model default

preferences.name: defaultTone
preferences.title: Default Tone
preferences.description: Tone to use when no tone is specified

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:bundle
